events.title: Brevard Womens Work Day
events.description: Join Pisgah Area SORBA for a Women's Trail Work Day on Mon day, August 24, from 5:30–7:30 PM ! Come spend an evening giving back to the trails, meeting other women who love the outdoors, and enjoying some time by the river. We'll be brushing back vegetation along the Davidson River Trail to improve the trail corridor and keep this popular trail looking its best. We'll meet at the Cove Creek Trailhead , making it easy to cool off with a swim in the Davidson River after the work is done. To top it all off, we'll fire up the grill afterward and enjoy some food and cold drinks together by the river! events.title: Catalyst Summer Jam Lunch Crew
events.description: We're looking for a few volunteers to help Pisgah Area SORBA cook lunch at Catalyst Sports End of Summer Jam . We'll be grilling burgers and hot dogs while representing PAS, talking trails, recruiting volunteers, and promoting upcoming work days. Catalyst Sports is a volunteer-led nonprofit that empowers people with physical disabilities through adaptive adventure sports, building confidence, community, and healthy, active lives. This is a fun way to support the local riding community and help spread the word about the work we're doing on the trails. events.title: Women's Bikepacking Overnight w/ Earth Mountain!
events.description: Women’s Overnight Bikepacking Trip with Earth Mountain! Join us for a women’s overnight bikepacking adventure through Pisgah National Forest with Earth Mountain! This bikepacking trip is a great opportunity to learn the basics, spend a night in the woods, and connect with other women who love riding and exploring. The total route is approximately 39 miles with 3,770 feet of climbing , with about 1,500 feet of climbing each day. The route includes options for gravel and single track, so both gravel and mountain bikes are welcome! Route : Looking Glass Loop Overnight What to Expect: Bring the good vibes: We're always stoked to be in biking and camping in the woods, and even moreso to share it with a rad group of ladies. events.title: Brevard Dig Day w/ CMC
events.description: Join Pisgah Area SORBA and the Carolina Mountain Club for a Trail Work Day in Pisgah! We’ll meet at the Fish Hatchery and hike in along Cat Gap to work on the trail. We’ll be partnering with the Carolina Mountain Club on this work day and are excited to continue working together! Come lend a hand as we work together to maintain and improve the trails we all love! No experience is necessary—our crew leaders will provide the tools, guidance, and instruction.
